mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) that impair glucose homeostasis and increase hypoglycemia risk; concurrent systemic infection and inflammatory response also increase insulin requirements unpredictably.
action: Monitor blood glucose frequently, anticipate variable insulin requirements, monitor renal function and electrolytes closely, correct electrolyte abnormalities promptly, and adjust insulin dosing based on glucose trends.
